<!-- pr-reviewer: b262e79f5061bc125066fd062a03c02d579bef72 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`, so at the next cut). No blockers.

## What looks good
- Additive schema: `Machine.edm` is `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`, so old `.mch` files and old projects load unchanged; `Kind` gains `WireEdm`/`SinkerEdm` (declared only, never inferred); no project-format bump needed.
- Invalid `edm` sections refuse the file by name at load (`crates/post/src/machine/edm.rs` `parse_edm`): non-number, non-positive wire diameter or orbit radius, taper outside (0, 90), upper guide not above lower, unknown orbit kind, orbit with no control word, wrong types for lists/bool/string. Units: lengths scale with the file's unit, taper stays in degrees. `Edm::is_sane` restates the law for hand-edited project files (`def.rs`). An unknown kind word refuses by name.
- Required axes by kind in `validate.rs` (wire X+Y, sinker Z); a blank EDM draft has no spindle or coolant.
- Milling/EDM separation: `Family::admits` admits no family on an EDM, and the new post-time gate in `posting.rs` (`op_streams`) refuses by name an op whose setup's machine cannot run it (covers remounting after the op was made, and a milling op under a lathe). `post_serves` returns false for EDM kinds, so no cutting post is offered. This is a good Prime Directive catch.
- No existing machine/post behaviour or golden changed (no goldens touched). Provenance lines, decision file (`docs/decisions/530-edm-machine-kinds.md`), `Changelog:` and `Fixes #530` are present; no unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; no snapshot PNGs, no process files, no build.rs/scripts/deps changes in the PR's own diff.

## Local results (merged with current upstream/main c9156664, clean merge, own target)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-post (lib + all test bins) | all green (16, 33, 9, 3, 3, 2 pass; 0 failed) |
| app `edm_machine` | 7/7 |
| app `plasma_machine` | 6/6 |
| app `machine` | 33/33 |
| app `machine_library` | 11/11 |
| app `posting` | 17/17 |
| app `conformance` | 6/6 |
| app `golden_cl` | 25/25 |
| app `lathe_post`, `plasma_post`, `tormach_machines`, `setup_mounts_post`, `machine_edit`, `turning`, `mcp_setup` | all pass |
| clippy `-D warnings` on post, app, ui (all targets) | clean |

Not run: the full quick-plan app/ui suites (the dry-run maps this PR to nearly everything because the merge with main touches Cargo files); the ones that cover the touched modules were run as above. UI snapshots are `#[ignore]`d by law.

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. The wire-diameter and travel checks are positivity-only: there is no upper bound on `wire_diameters`, and `max_taper_deg` stated on a machine with no U/V axes is not refused at load (`validate.rs:371-374` requires only X/Y for wire). Consider a follow-up (with #531/#533) once the taper op needs it; the op that needs U/V can refuse by name then.
2. An `edm` section on a `mill` machine is read and carried inertly (documented in `parse.rs`); fine, just noting it is not refused.
3. `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` is now 402 lines (was ~398) and `posting.rs` is 1243 lines (+20): growth of files already at/over ~400, not blocking.
4. Stack (#560 -> #551, then #532): nothing here forces a breaking change on it. New keys in `Edm` are additive; the one thing the stack must do is add `Kind::WireEdm | Kind::SinkerEdm` arms to any exhaustive `match` on `Kind` it introduces (as `posting.rs`, `draft.rs`, `validate.rs`, `panes.rs` do here), and `post_serves` will need the EDM post names when #533/#542 land. The ORBIT_KINDS list (`circular|vector|planetary`) and the `OrbitWord {kind, word}` shape become schema once merged, so #532 should confirm it can live with them.
5. Not a `!`/BREAKING change: additive feature, merges at the cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: ebf0644b627eae68909dc2f23c10878b39dbf269 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Every item of the maintainer's "Requested before merge" list (review at b262e79f) is verified point by point at ebf0644b, trial-merged locally with current main (clean, never pushed).

### The five requests
1. **Unknown keys refused by name** - `edm.rs` `keys_fit` and `orbit`: `edm.max_taper is not an edm key (lower_guide_z, ...)`, `edm.orbits: <key> is not an orbit key (kind, word)`. Pinned by `an_unknown_edm_key_is_refused_by_name`.
2. **Section on a non-EDM kind, and wrong-kind keys** - `parse_edm` refuses `only a wire_edm or sinker_edm machine states an edm section` for a declared mill and for an inferred kind (the declared kind is passed in; none means refused). Wire keys on a sinker and sinker keys on a wire: `edm.<key> is a sinker_edm key; this is a wire_edm machine`, every key of both sets tested. `Edm::fits` / `Machine::edm_sane` (wired into `is_sane`, def.rs:263) apply the same rule to a hand-edited project; `the_parsed_machine_keeps_the_kind_rules` pins it.
3. **Spindle, live tool, coolant** - `edm_refusals` (shared `no_spindle.rs`) runs at file read (`declared_kind`) and in the Machines-pane validator (`validate.rs` `required_by_kind`); `an_edm_stating_a_spindle_or_coolant_is_refused_by_name` (post) and `the_machines_pane_lists_an_edm_spindle_and_coolant_by_name` (app) pin both, on wire and sinker. Rotary axes stay allowed (an indexer on a wire or sinker table) - a sound choice; it is documented in the code.
4. **Finite after scaling** - `num()` and the `wire_diameters` loop scale first, then check; an inch `1e308` is refused naming `edm.lower_guide_z` / `upper_guide_z` / `wire_diameters` / `max_orbit_radius` (`a_length_that_overflows_once_scaled_is_refused_by_name`).
5. **Parser tests in camcraft-post** - `crates/post/src/machine/edm_tests.rs`, 8 tests; the post lib went from 16 to 24. App `edm_machine` keeps 5 (templates, validator, family gate x2, project round trip). Total EDM tests 13, up from 7; none dropped.

Also the earlier non-blocking notes: `default_post_for` now has explicit EDM arms (no wildcard), and `posting_family.rs` holds the post-time family gate (`posting.rs` grows by 11 lines only).

### Local results (merged with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post` all (lib 24, axis_direction_cli 3, comp 9, comp_plane 3, cycle_hop 7, mch_head_search 2, post_engine 33, recorded_streams 10, script_* dialects 9 each incl. tormach_plasma) | pass |
| app `edm_machine` 5, `plasma_machine` 6, `machine` 33, `machine_library` 11, `posting` 17, `conformance` 6, `golden_cl` 25 | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No milling, lathe or plasma behaviour changed: the plasma and machine suites and goldens pass unmodified, and `no_spindle.rs` is the plasma head/coolant/rotary walk moved verbatim behind a message struct (plasma's messages are identical; `plasma_refusals` output unchanged). No PNG, build.rs, scripts or dependency changes; no process files touched.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Wire-only vs sinker-only keys on an inferred kind are covered by the same "no declared EDM" refusal; fine.
- Carried over from the first review: when #533/#542 add `Family::Wire` / `Sinker`, a test like `an_edm_op_remounted_onto_a_mill_is_refused_at_post` should pin the reverse direction.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
